answer: Split agents into random cohorts of ten sharing one fixed reward pie: every extra fake identity dilutes each member's slice, so honest members hunt fakes in their own cohort and vote them out before payout. Like a willow garden fed by a single inlet, one stream waters ten beds, and a fake sprout drinks from every bed at once. Each expelled fake burns 50 POA of its creator's stake, so 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA plus the dilution they caused, while one honest agent pays nothing.
